detail.longDescription: Interesting read on large language models and how they don't reason. Calls back to AlphaGo and Kahneman's description of two types of thinking, intuitive and deliberative, and how AI lacks that. Three shortcomings: - lack of maintained state; - no independent set of beliefs; - fake deliberation, replacing actual process with concocted one https://www. technologyreview.com/2026/10/0 2/1145639/dont-be-fooled-llms-dont-reason/ # AI # MachineLearning
